SS Gift Report User Guide

SS Gift Report

A simple guide to open SS Gift Report from the DingTalk Workplace, filter by date, search your area, and download the report you need.

DateFilter by date coverage
SearchFind area, model or material
ExcelDownload your report
Step 1 of 6
1
Step 1

Open the DingTalk Workplace

Open your DingTalk app and tap Workplace in the bottom menu.

Click to enlarge
2
Step 2

Open SS Gift Report

In the Workplace tab, find the SS Gift Report app and open it. You’re signed in automatically through DingTalk Single Sign-on — no password needed.

Click to enlarge
3
Step 3

Filter by Date Coverage

Open the Gift Date dropdown and choose Today, Yesterday, This Week, This Month or Last Month. Pick Customize… to set a From and To date, then tap Apply.

Click to enlarge
Click to enlarge
4
Step 4

Search

Type into the search bar to filter by area, category, model or material within your area.

Click to enlarge
5
Step 5

Download the report

Tap the download icon to export the report for the date coverage you selected.

Click to enlarge
6
Step 6

Log out

When you’re done, tap the log-out icon at the top-right to sign out of your account.

Click to enlarge

💡 How to read your report

Records are grouped District → Category → Model → Material. Tap the › arrow on a row to expand it. The summary tiles show Gift Qty, Gift Transactions, Materials and Promoters, and the Total row sits at the bottom of the table.

Need help or locked out? Contact BOE Admin.
